_note: The intel room: the floor of the first placed object of base_asset (the military hangar), with the screen on a free-standing board near its back end, facing the front opening. Its screen shows every announced event (when, what, risks, where); with several it shows one at a time, rotate_seconds each, and only within view_range_m of the camera. room is in the object's own frame (before its rotation and scale): floor_m = floor top above its origin, at = [x, z] of the screen's middle on the wall, facing = [x, z] unit vector into the room, bottom_m = lower edge above the floor; width_m x height_m is the screen's size. Nothing reads the model, so it is the same for a player without the pack. open_parts = node names of the prefab that are hidden and stop colliding so players can walk in (none for the open hangar). The prefab SM_Bld_Hangar_Open_01 (30.6 x 36.3 m, both ends open, side walls inside at about x = -13.6 and x = +13.6) is an arched vault with no flat wall, so the screen is a free-standing board on two posts in the middle of the hall, 13 m towards the -z (back) end, facing the +z (front) opening; the first such object is the west hangar of the military base (parcel P-0349). A map without the object falls back to the command post of base_bunker (an id of the map's bunkers.json; w378900206 stands nearest the church); with neither there is no intel room, and the announcement still reaches everyone.
